title: Packed get_clg2 archimedean assembly
objective: Implement and differentially verify the packed get_clg2 archimedean assembly leaf for GD and ga on an authentic cubic fixture

oracles: Pristine PARI 2.17.4 exact packed-output oracle on an authentic cubic class-group fixture

handoff.summary: Implemented the packed get_clg2 archimedean leaf with reusable transform workspaces and delayed result publication. A pristine PARI 2.17.4 oracle runs bnfinit on x^3-10*x^2-30*x-195, rebuilds Ga from stored Ge through nf_cxlog, and authenticates both identities against PARI's stored GD and ga. Exact packed outputs agree under CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged execution; malformed dimensions preserve public outputs and the documented output/input alias mode passes.
risks: Only the authentic accepted cubic shape rows=2, inner=active=1 is qualified; wider active<=inner shapes are implemented but not yet backed by an authentic fixture.
The two result owners and three scratch owners must remain mutually disjoint; separate IntegerBuffer arguments do not expose portable owner identity for a dynamic rejection.

The base commit's portable suite has an unrelated modular q-expansion source-freeze mismatch in architecture/package-graph.json (actual acf5c55b..., frozen 66d0eec3...); the focused oracle, architecture check, and strict baselib check pass.
next_steps: Wire pari_get_clg2_arch after Smith transforms and genback/nf_cxlog provide C, Ga, cyc, Ur, M1, and M2 owners.
Add a wider authentic class-group fixture if a later integration state exposes active<inner or multiple nontrivial invariants.
